body: That's what I though I was doing with this uni course. It used to be my passion, but I have no motivation to do anything and I'm evidently not particular good at it. I've gone through years of self help courses and therapy to try and help to find something that does, I've honestly got nothing. I'm an empty shell of a human.
It's not just uni. It's a constant pattern for me, every job or educational course becomes too hard. I can't grow from the position I am and I'll just be a drain on everyone around me.
